lines.text: Hello from above the clouds! This is Nova, live from a court floating under the stars, with the planet rising behind the rim.
Welcome aboard! Nova on the mic, broadcasting from Orbit, where the stars are the ceiling and gravity is strictly optional.
Mission control, we are live. This is Nova, and this is the Zero-G Classic. Seatbelts off, eyes up!
Stars out, planet up, lights on. Nova here, and you are floating at Orbit, home of the Zero-G Classic!
Observation deck, let me hear you! Louder than a launch!
Upper ring, you are quiet up there. Make some noise for Orbit!
Shout-out to the Comet Kids in row zero, loudest seats in the galaxy!
Big welcome to Professor Pip, front row, telescope and all!
Countdown with me, Orbit! Three, two, one... noise!
Night shift crew by the airlock, stand up! You earned it.
Forecast for tonight: clear skies, light solar wind, and a small chance of meteors near the three-point line.
Somebody's water bottle has been orbiting the scoreboard since spring. We call it a moon now.
The concession pod has freeze-dried nachos tonight. Hold on to the chips, they float.
A fan asked if the planet behind the backboard is real. Very real. It just likes basketball.
Last season a ball left orbit on a bad pass. Mission control still gets a postcard every year.
Quick reminder: the last shuttle home leaves after the final horn. Nobody sleeps on the court. Again.
Mission control says the stars are aligned tonight. Mission control says that every night.
Beautiful night up here. Then again, it is always night up here.
Thrusters warming up! Here we go!
Engines are humming now. Feel that?
Fuel is flowing, Orbit. Something's building.
We are cleared for liftoff! Orbit is up!
Full thrust! The whole deck is standing!
Now you are climbing! Keep that altitude!
Escape velocity! Nothing can pull this one down!
Afterburners! The whole court is floating!
Gravity just gave up! Cannot miss!
Out of the atmosphere! Nobody touch anything!
Engines went quiet. Relight them, you got this.
Running on backup power. Reboot and go again.
Little turbulence, that is all. Stay the course.
Mission accomplished! Touchdown confirmed. Take your victory lap around the moon!
That is a champion of the Zero-G Classic! Write that name across the stars!
Stuck the landing, start to finish. Orbit salutes you. Safe travels home, and come back soon!
The stars came out for you tonight, and you delivered. Nova, signing off happy!
Every great mission has a few scrubbed launches first. Refuel, and come back to Orbit.
The flight ends here, my friend. The launch pad will be waiting when you are ready.
Gravity won this round. Rematch? Orbit says yes. Nova says yes. Get back up here!
Hands together for our cadet, Orbit! Brave flight. The next launch window opens soon.
Launch day, Orbit! Flight Night is go. Two rounds, two dunks each, five judges at mission control, and a rival already on the pad.
Orbit, it is Flight Night! Five judges, two rounds, two dunks apiece. Tonight's rival is fueled up and waiting.
Countdown to Flight Night begins now! Two rounds of two dunks, five judges scoring every landing, and one rival standing between you and the stars.
Back for another Flight Night? Orbit never gets tired of a return mission.
Look who docked again! Refueled, rested, and ready for another night of flight.
Another launch, another night under the stars. The pad is yours again.
Tonight's rival just arrived in Orbit, and nobody gets up here by accident.
Across the court, a rival with a flight plan of their own. Engines are warming.
Cass, tonight's rival: flies on autopilot, lands every time, tomahawk loaded. Zero surprises.
Ty brings maximum thrust, every launch, every night. Watch out for that windmill.
Pilot. Yes, really. Scans the sky, then makes the call. Three-sixty on deck.
Zo is in it for the highlight reel. Phones up, Orbit. Zo wants the replay.
Stack launches the wildest dunk first and asks questions at re-entry. Between the legs, probably.
Cadet on the pad. All eyes up.
Launch window is open. Your dunk, your sky.
Orbit, quiet on deck. Our flyer is up.
Tower, stand by. Here comes the flight.
All systems go. Show us something new.
Systems reset. Take it from the top.
Second attempt. Same flight plan, better landing.
Recalibrating. You have another shot at it.
Engines still warm, cadet. Go again!
Final attempt. This launch window is closing.
Last shot at orbit. Stick the landing.
Third and final. All eyes on the pad.
Ignition!
Engines hot...
Three, two, one!
Here comes liftoff!
Go for launch!
Clean launch, clean landing...
Touchdown confirmed...
Into the flight log...
Solid flight, cadet...
Right on the flight plan...
Safe landing, points on the board...
Ooh, now that had some altitude!
Readings are strong on that one!
Smooth re-entry, and the deck approves!
Look at the hang time on that!
Well, well! Somebody brought extra fuel!
That one cleared the upper deck!
Beautiful flight path, beautiful finish!
Orbit, that is how you fly!
We have altitude! We have altitude!
Oh, stop the countdown! Stop everything!
Gravity just filed a complaint!
Mission control, are you seeing this?!
Whoa! That one left the atmosphere!
Somebody call the observatory!
New star in the sky, folks!
Orbit is shaking! The planet is shaking!
Rewrite the flight manual!
Put that one in the star charts!
Fifty! Perfect score! Mission control is on its feet!
Five judges, five tens. That is a perfect orbit!
Perfect fifty! Paint it on the side of the rocket!
Ten, ten, ten, ten, ten! Flawless flight!
Seen it! That flight plan already flew tonight.
Repeat flight! The judges already logged that one.
Same orbit, same view. The judges want a new route.
Nice landing, but that satellite already launched tonight.
Mission scrubbed! Back to the pad.
Abort, abort! The rim said negative.
We lost the signal on that one.
Rough landing, cadet. Shake it off.
Gravity wins that round.
So close to touchdown. Almost had it.
Off the iron and back into orbit!
Circled the rim like a moon, then out!
So close! The docking clamps would not hold!
That lob slipped out of orbit!
Where is that ball going? Deep space!
Missed the rendezvous. The ball never docked.
Clipped it on the way up!
Contact with the obstacle! Landing gear caught.
Obstacle clearance: negative. So close!
Launch window closed. That one goes down as a miss.
Out of attempts. Mission scrubbed, but the night goes on.
Three tries, no touchdown. Logged as a miss.
Mission control, your scores?
Judges are conferring...
Transmitting scores now...
Awaiting the verdict...
Rival on the pad. Clear the runway.
Next launch belongs to the rival. Eyes up.
Cass on the pad. Autopilot engaged.
Ty is up. Brace for thrust.
Pilot, you are cleared for takeoff.
Zo is up, and the cameras know it.
Stack is up. Something wild is coming.
The rival sticks the landing...
Solid flight from across the court...
Respect to the other crew...
Ooh, the rival found some altitude!
Cass, autopilot, perfect landing...
Ty with the heavy thrust, as advertised...
Pilot calculated every inch of that...
Zo plays to the cameras, and delivers...
Stack went for the wild one, and landed...
Rival misses! Your mission is very much alive.
Scrubbed on the other side! Opening for you.
Off the rim! That is a gift!
Hard landing for the rival. Stay ready.
No touchdown! The rival comes up empty.
Round two, final round! Next stop, the stars.
Final round at Flight Night! Everything you have, all engines.
Stage two separation! We are in the final round, Orbit!
Trailing into the final round. You need big altitude now.
Behind on the board, cadet. Time to burn every drop of fuel.
Big numbers needed, cadet. Go higher than you have ever gone.
You are ahead, cadet. Bring this mission home. Smooth and steady.
Leading into the final round. Keep it clean, close it out.
Mission control, confirm it: we have a new commander of the sky!
Touchdown! Our cadet wins Flight Night, and Orbit will be talking about it for light-years.
The planet rose tonight just to watch you fly. What a champion, cadet!
What a flight! The rival is grounded, and the stars are yours tonight.
The rival takes Flight Night. Tough one, cadet, but you flew with everything.
Mission incomplete, cadet. The hangar is open, and the pad will wait.
Crown goes to the rival tonight. Orbit saw real flight from you, though.
Refuel, regroup, relaunch, cadet. The rival wins this one, not the next.
Down in the splits! Zero gravity, full flexibility!
It's over? Mission control concurs!
Listen to that roar! Louder than liftoff!
Too small! That rim looked tiny from orbit!
Arms up! The whole observation deck rises!
Controller changes hands. Next cadet to the pad!
Crew change! Pass it over, new flight up.
Handing off to player one. Controls are yours!
Player two, you are cleared for launch!
That settles the Dunk Duel! Touchdown for the winner!
Player one takes the Dunk Duel! New commander on deck!
Victory for player two! Bragging rights, now in orbit!
Perfectly tied! Two ships, one orbit, no winner yet.
Level at the finish! Same altitude, same score.
Orbit, this is Downtown! Six shooters, five racks, sixty seconds on the clock, and only the top three advance.
Downtown is open for launch! Five racks, sixty seconds, money balls worth double. Six shooters, three seats in the final.
Long-range mission tonight, Orbit! Sixty seconds, five racks, watch those money balls. Top three of six move on.
Clock is live!
Launch sequence started!
Ignition! Go!
Coordinates set, next rack!
Fresh rack, fresh fuel!
Keep the rhythm, next rack!
On to the next station!
Last rack! Final approach!
Final rack. Bring it home!
One rack left. Full burn!
Money ball! Worth two!
Here comes the money ball!
Priority payload!
Precious cargo! Worth double!
Touchdown!
Nothing but stars!
Docked!
Right on target!
Splashdown!
Clean landing!
Money ball, touchdown! Double!
Precious cargo delivered!
Payload secured!
Cash in the cosmos!
Off target.
No landing.
Rim says negative.
Just missed.
Short of orbit.
Locked on target now!
String of landings!
Rhythm is locked in!
All systems green!
Supernova! Every single one!
Clean rack! A perfect orbit!
Light speed, Downtown! Unstoppable!
The basket is a black hole!
Three straight misses. Time to recalibrate.
Lost the signal. Find it again!
Engines sputtering. Deep breath, reset.
Ten seconds! Countdown is on!
Hurry! Ten seconds left!
Launch window closing! Ten seconds!
After the horn, and it counts!
Released in time! That one counts!
Beat the clock! Points secured!
Results are coming in from mission control. Shooter by shooter.
Transmitting the qualifying numbers now. Six shooters, three seats.
Next stage ignites soon, and you are on board!
Stage one complete! Our cadet advances to the Downtown final!
Qualified! You are cleared for the final round.
Not this orbit. Qualifying ends here, but the range is always open.
Just short of the final. Recalibrate the jumper and come back.
Mission scrubbed in qualifying. Downtown will be here next launch.
Countdown to the final! You go last, and you know the number. Launch it!
Last launch of Downtown. The target is on the board. Hit it.
Final round, final shooter. The mark is set. Now top it.
Past the mark! It is won!
That clinches it! Mission complete!
Orbit achieved! Nobody catches you now!
Downtown champion! Sharpest shooter in the solar system, and it is official!
Mission control, record it! Three-point champion of the Zero-G Classic!
Crown them, Orbit! Longest range in the galaxy, and a trophy to match!
Ones at Orbit! One on one, first to eleven, make it take it. Two hoopers, one court, zero gravity.
Mission briefing: one on one, first to eleven, and if you score, you keep the ball. Launch!
Threes at Orbit! Three on three, first to twenty-one, and ninety seconds on the clock. Crew up!
Full crew mission! Three a side, first to twenty-one, ninety-second clock. Mission control, start the countdown!
Check ball. Shields up, cadet.
Their ball. Guard your airspace.
Defense! Hold the orbit!
Ball checked. Protect the pad.
Touchdown from midrange!
Pull-up, and it lands!
Smooth launch, clean landing!
Jumper is good!
Right on the flight path!
Docked it, nice and smooth!
From deep space! Three!
Long-range launch, good!
Outer ring, and it lands!
Beyond the arc, beyond gravity!
Satellite shot, it drops!
Soft landing at the rim!
Smooth re-entry, and in!
Up and in, gentle docking!
Easy touchdown inside!
We have liftoff!
Rocket to the rim!
Ooh, full-power flush!
Launched and landed!
Altitude check: plenty!
Posterized into orbit! Unreal!
Eclipsed the defender completely!
Cleared the defender! We have altitude!
Defender turned launch pad! Whoa!
Hang it next to the planet!
Mission control, that was a poster!
And one! Through the turbulence!
Contact, and it still lands!
Fouled, and it counts anyway!
Extra fuel at the line!
Off the rim.
No landing there.
Missed the docking.
Drifted wide.
Airball! Missed the whole planet!
Off the radar entirely!
Orbit saw that. Everybody did.
Where was that headed? Mars?
Launch denied!
Rejected into deep space!
Force field! Blocked!
Sent right back to earth!
No-fly zone!
Asteroid deflected!
Launch intercepted!
Denied re-entry!
Stuffed at the pad!
Grounded by the defender!
Intercepted! Signal captured!
Picked clean out of orbit!
Swiped! Change of mission!
Cargo recovered!
Tractor beam! Ball is yours!
Cargo lost in transit!
Stripped. Signal lost.
Ball drifted away! Get back!
Pickpocketed in zero gravity!
Ankles lost in space!
Crossover! Gravity took the defender!
Whoa! Defender down, orbit wobbling!
Shook them out of orbit!
Ha! Who turned gravity up?
Somebody help the defender up!
Took the bait! Launched early!
Fake launch! Defender bought it!
Up went the defender!
Pump fake, false alarm!
Whistle! Mission paused.
Hold the countdown. Whistle.
Red light! There's a call.
Stoppage. The tower is reviewing.
Incoming score. Stay on course.
Opponents on the board. Refocus.
Their launch lands. Respond!
Scored on. Shields back up!
Other side docks one. Stay steady.
Their rocket reached the rim!
Heavy landing, other side. Answer back!
They found altitude. Your turn next.
Thrown down from orbit! Regroup!
Unanswered buckets! This mission is on autopilot!
Scoring streak! Orbit cannot look away!
Three straight and climbing! Keep the engines lit!
Nobody is answering! Full thrust run!
Game point! One bucket from touchdown!
Their game point. Hold the line, cadet!
That is the game! Touchdown, and the run is yours!
Game winner! Into the flight log!
Ballgame! Our cadet runs this orbit!
Final bucket lands! Victory at Orbit!
Their run. Refuel, cadet, and check back in.
Game goes to the other side. Good run, though.
Rough re-entry. Orbit still wants the rematch.
Equal power at the horn! Two crews, perfectly even.
Even at the buzzer! Share the sky tonight.
What a feed! Delivered!
Perfect handoff to the crew!
Coordinates sent! Bucket!
Guided it right in!
Alley-oop! Up and slammed!
Lob up, and liftoff!
Midair rendezvous! Beautiful!
Ten seconds! Countdown is live!
Final ten! Every second counts!
Clock is burning, ten seconds!
Overdrive! The whole crew is synced!
Hyperdrive engaged! Full crew thrust!
All engines, full power!
Now boarding: Game Night! Four stops on tonight's flight, points at each, and one champion lands on top.
Game Night is go! Four missions tonight, points on each, one champion walks away with the stars.
Four events, one champion, and every point counts. Mission control, open Game Night!
Slam Rush! Twenty seconds, dunk as many as you can!
Next up, Strike Storm! Land your hits on the pads, full thrust!
Trick Gauntlet! Board up, and stick every landing!
Hot Shot is up! Shots on goal, lock on and launch!
Coin Storm incoming! Meteor shower of coins, grab all you can!
Counter mission! Wait for the jab, then answer in the window!
Blast off!
Launch!
Engines on, go!
Five seconds! Burn it!
Final five, full thrust!
Countdown: five seconds left!
Points secured, cadet! Log that event!
Mission complete! That event is yours.
You take it! Orbit loved every second.
Touchdown! That event belongs to you!
Rival lands that one. Reset for the next launch.
That event goes the other way. Stay in orbit!
Scrubbed that one. The rival banks the points.
Even! Split the points, share the sky.
A tie! Not even radar can separate you.
Controller handoff! Player two, engines on!
Crew swap! Pass the controller to player two.
Game Night champion! Four events, one commander, and every star shining for you!
Crown secured! Mission control, put the champion's name up in lights across the sky!
Top of the whole Game Night! We have altitude, and we have a champion!
Good flying, cadet. The rival takes Game Night, but the launch pad stays open.
Game Night goes the other way. Refuel, regroup, and come back for the rematch.
